propositions: The documented curl command using git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg resolves to the shared hooks directory from linked worktrees, causing it to overwrite the pre-commit wrapper in the main checkout instead of installing locally.

Installing the commit-msg hook via the documented curl clobbers the pre-commit wrapper chain, disabling the 50/72 message linting rule and breaking Change-Id stamping silently until git push to Gerrit fails.
The installation failure is invisible at commit time and only surfaces during git push gerrit, potentially in a different worktree than the one where the curl command was run.

The fix consolidates hook installation into a single idempotent make hooks target that correctly handles both pre-commit wrapper and Gerrit Change-Id stamper via scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh, removing the bare curl from AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.
The new installation script is cwd-independent, non-destructive to pre-commit wrappers, idempotent, and refuses unsafe overwrites with loud errors rather than silent failures.
